Manipulate the Board Build structures to overcome the randomness of the physics-based world. Have Fun Create black holes, control weather, turn off gravity, duplicate your balls and much more... Many levels feature anomalies and bonus cards that enhance your experience. Features Pachinko-based production mechanics. Active / semi-idle Incremental gameplay. Relaxing pace with no time pressure. Level-based progression. Anomalies, Plinko modes and roguelite-inspired bonus cards. Features

Pachinko Farm is designed for players who enjoy watching numbers go up, building efficient systems, and experiencing slow but satisfying incremental progression.
